welcome.title: Wamkelekile kwi-Campus Companion
welcome.body: Iiveki zakho zokuqala eyunivesithi zinokubonakala zininzi, kwaye oko kuqhelekile ngokupheleleyo. Le app ibeka into oyifunayo kwindawo enye. Thatha uhambo lomzuzu omnye. Awunakwenza nto ephosakeleyo.
welcome.hint: Tsiba nangaliphi na ixesha. Ungayidlala kwakhona le nkqubo kwiProfayile yakho.

home.title: Isiseko sakho
home.body: IKhaya libonisa izaziso zamva nje, amaxesha e-shuttle esitishini sakho, kunye neencam ezikhawulezayo kuzo zonke ezinye izinto. Uphawu lwe-ENTSHA lubonisa ukuba isaziso sikhutshwe kutshanje kwaye awukasivuli.
home.hint: Rola ezantsi kwiKhaya ukufumana Ezemidlalo ne-gym, iinkqubo nemibuzo.

search.title: Fumana nantoni na ngokukhawuleza
search.body: Awuqinisekanga ukuba ujonge phi? Sebenzisa ibha yokukhangela. Ikhangela iimpendulo, iindawo, iiseshoni, abantu ofowunela bona neezikhokelo, zonke ngaxeshanye.

schedule.title: Yazi ukuba kufuneka ube phi, nini
schedule.body: Jonga iiseshoni zakho zoqhelaniso namaxesha neendawo zazo. Tshintshela kwiziganeko zekhampasi ukubona okwenzekayo ekhampasini.

map.title: Ungalahleki
map.body: Imephu yekhampasi ibonisa izakhiwo neendawo. Fumana indawo ufumane indlela yokuhamba ngeenyawo ukuya kuyo.

checklist.title: Phawula izinto ezibalulekileyo
checklist.body: Uluhlu lwabafundi abatsha lubonisa into ekufuneka uyilungiselele kwiiveki zakho zokuqala, njengokubhalisa ne-imeyile yakho yomfundi. Hamba ngesantya sakho uphawule njengoko ugqiba.

digital.title: Zilungiselele idijithali
digital.body: Izikhokelo ngenyathelo ngenyathelo zeFunda, i-Wi-Fi nokuprinta, kunye nezifundo ezimfutshane ngolawulo lweefayile, ukhuseleko kwi-intanethi, amagama okugqitha anamandla nokusebenzisa izixhobo ze-AI ngokuzibophelela.

tribe.title: Hlangana neQela lakho
tribe.body: IQela lakho yincoko nomkhokeli wakho nabanye abafundi bonyaka wokuqala. Ngaphambi kokuba ukhethe igama lencoko uya kuvuma ukuyigcina inembeko. Cofa Fumana amaqela ukujonga amaqela abakhokeli okanye uskeneye ikhowudi ye-QR.

help.title: Uncedo lusoloko luseduze
help.body: Awuqinisekanga ukuba ubuza bani? Vula iNkxaso, khetha into ofuna uncedo ngayo, kwaye i-app ikubonisa umntu okanye inkonzo efanelekileyo. Abafowunelwa babonisa abakhokeli nabacebisi onokuqhagamshelana nabo ngqo. Ngoncedo olungxamisekileyo, sebenzisa ikhadi elibomvu leeNombolo zongxamiseko eKhaya.

profile.title: Yenze eyakho
profile.body: KwiProfayile ungatshintshela phakathi kwesiNgesi, isiXhosa nesiAfrikansi, ukhethe imo ekhanyayo okanye emnyama, wenze nombhalo ube mkhulu. Ungayidlala kwakhona le nkqubo apho nanini na.

boarding-requirement.title: Imfuneko yokukhwela
boarding-requirement.text: Ukukhwela i-shuttle, bonke abafundi kufuneka babonise ikhadi lomfundi elisebenzayo kunye nobungqina bokwamkelwa okanye ileta yokubhalisa.

early-arrival.title: Ukufika kwangoko
early-arrival.text: Abafundi abafuna ukufika kwangoko ekhampasini bacetyiswa ukuba bathathe i-shuttle yokuqala eyicwangcisiweyo yosuku.

assistance.title: Uncedo
assistance.text: Oomarshal be-shuttle bakhona ukunceda. Abafundi abangaqinisekanga ukuba yeyiphi i-shuttle echanekileyo kufuneka babuze uMarshal ngesikhokelo.

code-of-conduct.title: Umthetho wokuziphatha
code-of-conduct.text: Abafundi kufuneka balandele imiyalelo yooMarshal nabaqhubi ngalo lonke ixesha. Ukuziphatha ngokungenanhlonipho okanye ukwala ukuthobela kuya kubangela ukumiswa kwangoko kwamalungelo eenkonzo ze-shuttle.

prohibited-items-and-behaviour.title: Izinto nokuziphatha okuthintelweyo
prohibited-items-and-behaviour.text: Akuvumelekanga ukutya okanye ukusela ngaphakathi kwii-shuttle. Utywala luthintelwe ngokuqinileyo. Nawuphi na umfundi obonakala edakiwe akayi kuvunyelwa ukukhwela.

conduct.title: Ngaphambi kokuba ujoyine incoko
conduct.intro: IQela liyinxalenye yeeplatifomu zonxibelelwano zikawonke-wonke zeNelson Mandela University. Oko ukubhalayo apha kukumela wena neYunivesithi, ngoko sikugcina kuhloniphekile kwaye kukhuselekile kumntu wonke.
conduct.respect: Ndiza kuphatha wonke umntu kwiQela ngentlonelo: umkhokeli wam, abaququzeleli nomfundi ngamnye.
conduct.bully: Andiyi kuhlukumeza, ndiphazamise, ndisongele, ndihlazise okanye ndikhuphe mntu ngaphandle.
conduct.swear: Andiyi kuthuka okanye ndisebenzise ulwimi olunyelisayo, olubonisa inzondo okanye olucalulayo.
conduct.private: Ndiza kugcina iinkcukacha zam nezabanye abantu ziyimfihlo.
conduct.watched: Ndiyaqonda ukuba abakhokeli nabaququzeleli bangafunda imiyalezo yeQela, nokuba imiyalezo eyaphula le mithetho ingasuswa.

boundaries.b1: Ungumhlobo we-FYS, hayi umcebisi. Ngenkxalabo enzulu ngokhuseleko okanye impilo, thumela umfundi kwinkxaso yobuchule kwaye uxelele abaququzeleli boqhelaniso.

buddyVenues.subtitle: Awuqinisekanga ukuba into ikuphi? Abafundi abaninzi abaqinisekanga. Nika izalathiso ezicacileyo, ezinobubele uze ubonelele ngokuhamba nabo ukuba unako.

soc.title: Fumana abantu bakho
soc.subtitle: Ukholo, intsimi yezifundo, okanye into eyahlukileyo kwaphela. Ukujoyina enye yeyona ndlela ekhawulezayo yokuyeka ukuziva ungumntu ongaziwayo apha.
soc.incomplete: Olu luhlu aluphelelanga: jonga inqaku elingezantsi. Ukuba umbutho wakho awukho apha, usenokubakho. Buza kwi-Student Governance and Development.
soc.aboutText: Ithathwe kwiphepha lokubhalisa imibutho eliprintiweyo, elinqunyulwe ezantsi kwephepha, ngoko amacandelo eZemfundo neNkqubela aphelele. Iindleko neekhowudi zinokutshintsha phakathi kweminyaka. Qinisekisa phambi kokuhlawula.
soc.whatIs: Umbutho yiklabhu eqhutywa ngabafundi onokujoyina unyaka. Ezinye zakhelwe ngokwenkolo, ezinye ngokwento oyifundayo, kwaye ezinye ngenjongo okanye ubuchule obungenanto yakwenza nesidanga sakho. Uhlawula ifizi encinci kanye, kwaye ubuya nabantu esele beyazi into odlula kuyo. Akufuneki ube nobuchule kuyo nayiphi na into, wazi mntu, okanye ubophelele kuwo wonke umhlangano: ukuvela kanye kwanele ukuqala.

about.label: MALUNGA NEPROJEKTHI
about.subtitle: I-app yoqhelaniso lwabafundi beSikolo se-IT
about.summary: Yakhelwe ukunceda abafundi bonyaka wokuqala beSikolo se-IT bazive bamkelekile, benolwazi kwaye belungile. Ibeka ishedyuli yoqhelaniso, iindawo, abafowunelwa, imibuzo eqhelekileyo, inkxaso nezikhokelo zezakhono zedijithali kwindawo enye, ukuze kungabikho mntu kufuneka aqokelele oko kwii-imeyile nakwimiyalezo.
about.status: Le yiprototype ye-hackathon. Umxholo obonisiweyo unokuba yidatha yesampulu de abasebenzi bapapashe inkqubo yoqhelaniso yokwenene.

principles.courage: Amanyathelo alandelayo acacileyo nempumelelo emincinci, ukuze ukuthatha inyathelo lokuqala kubonakale kunokwenzeka.
principles.empathy: Ulwimi olunobubele, olulula. Asisoze sicinge ukuba usele uyazi ukuba iyunivesithi isebenza njani.
principles.vulnerability: Ukungayazi into okwangoku kuqhelekile. Izikhokelo nemibuzo eqhelekileyo zikho ngenxa yoko.
principles.shame: Uphosise iseshoni okanye uziva ulahlekile? Uya kuhlala ubonisiwe into emayenziwe okulandelayo, ungasoze utyholwe.

features.f1: IKhaya enezaziso, amaxesha e-shuttle nenkqubela yakho
features.f2: Ukukhangela kwishedyuli, kwimibuzo eqhelekileyo, kubafowunelwa, kwiindawo nakwiinketho zoncedo

features.f6: Izikhokelo zokulungela idijithali: izakhono zekhompyutha, iFunda, ukuprinta ne-Wi-Fi
features.f8: Iindlela zenkxaso ("Ndifuna uncedo ngo...") nabafowunelwa abaphambili

who.text: Imiyalezo yeQela ibonakala kubafundi kwiQela lakho nakubasebenzi boqhelaniso, abanceda ukugcina indawo ikhuselekile. Inkqubela yakho yeyakho wedwa.

device.text: Ulwimi lwakho, ubungakanani bombhalo nemo, ukukhangela kwakho kokugqibela, kunye nekopi egciniweyo yeshedyuli, imibuzo eqhelekileyo nabafowunelwa ukuze zisebenze ngaphandle kwe-intanethi.

map.label: Imephu yekhampasi
map.text: Imephu ilayisha imifanekiso neendlela zokuhamba kwiinkonzo zasimahla ezisekelwe kwi-OpenStreetMap. Zifumana kuphela ukuba yeyiphi inxalenye yemephu oyijongayo nezinto zokuqala nezokugqibela zendlela. I-app ayisebenzisi i-GPS kwaye ayikhe ilandelele ukuba ukuphi. Igama lakho ne-akhawunti azikhe zithunyelwe.

approach.label: Indlela yethu
approach.text: Yenzelwe ngokucinga imigaqo ye-POPIA: qokelela kuphela into efunekayo, kwaye ugcine iinkcukacha zobuqu ziyimfihlo.

about.helpText: Le app ikubonisa apho ufumana uncedo. Ayilithatheli indawo. Ukuba uyasokola, okanye wena okanye omnye umntu usemngciphekweni, qhagamshelana nezinkonzo zengcebiso nezempilo zeyunivesithi okanye iinkonzo zokhuselo lwekhampasi ngoko nangoko. Ukucela uncedo kwangoko yinto ehlakaniphileyo nenembopheleleko.

steps.1: Jonga uluhlu olusekhohlo. IiDocuments, iiDownloads ne-Desktop ziindawo apho iifayile zakho zinokuhlala khona.
steps.2: Cofa kabini kwifolda ukuyivula. Cofa utolo lokubuya ngasemva ngaphezulu ukuya inqanaba elinye ngentla.
steps.3: Ukwenza ifolda yakho, cofa ngasekunene kwindawo engenanto, khetha i-New, uze ukhethe i-Folder.
steps.4: Chwetheza igama lefolda uze ucinezele i-Enter. Ifolda yakho ilungele ukusetyenziswa.

files-1-files-and-folders.tip: Uninzi lwezinto ozikhuphelayo luphelela kwi-Downloads. Shenxisela ezo ufuna ukuzigcina kwiifolda zakho.

files-2-naming-and-organising.title: Ukunika amagama nokucwangcisa
files-2-naming-and-organising.summary: Isicwangciso esilula sefolda ukuze ufumane umsebenzi wakho ngokukhawuleza.
files-2-naming-and-organising.desc: Amagama acacileyo nesicwangciso esilula sefolda kuthetha ukuba ungafumana umsebenzi wakho ngemizuzwana, nasebusuku phambi komhla wokuphela.

steps.0: Yenza ifolda enye ephambili yonyaka, umzekelo '2027 First Year'.
steps.1: Ngaphakathi kuyo, yenza ifolda enye kwimodyuli nganye, enje ngo-'Programming' okanye 'Networks'.
steps.2: Ngaphakathi kwifolda nganye yemodyuli, yongeza i-'Assignments', i-'Notes' ne-'Study material'.
steps.3: Nika iifayile amagama azicacisayo, anje ngo-'Programming - Assignment 1 - Draft.docx'.
steps.4: Phepha amagama anjenge-'final', 'final2' okanye 'new'. Yongeza umhla okanye inani loguqulelo endaweni yalo, njenge-'v2'.
steps.5: Ukuphinda unike ifayile igama, cofa kanye kuyo, cinezela i-F2, chwetheza igama elitsha uze ucinezele i-Enter.

files-2-naming-and-organising.tip: I-Windows ayivumeli ezi zimpawu kwigama lefayile: / \ : * ? " < > |

files-3-save-copy-move.title: Ukugcina, ukukopa nokushenxisa
files-3-save-copy-move.summary: Gcina umsebenzi wakho, yenza uguqulelo lwesibini, okanye uwubeke kwenye indawo.
files-3-save-copy-move.desc: Ukugcina kugcina umsebenzi wakho. Ukukopa kwenza uguqulelo lwesibini. Ukushenxisa kubeka eyoqobo kwenye indawo.

steps.0: Gcina njengoko usebenza. Kwiiprogram ezininzi, cinezela i-Ctrl ne-S kunye, uyenze rhoqo emva kwemizuzu embalwa.
steps.1: Xa ugcina okokuqala, khetha ifolda uze uchwetheze igama elicacileyo. Sebenzisa i-Save As ukugcina olunye uguqulelo phantsi kwegama elitsha.
steps.2: Ukukopa ifayile, cofa kuyo, cinezela i-Ctrl ne-C, vula ifolda oyifunayo, uze ucinezele i-Ctrl ne-V.
steps.3: Ukushenxisa ifayile, cofa kuyo, cinezela i-Ctrl ne-X, vula ifolda oyifunayo, uze ucinezele i-Ctrl ne-V.
steps.4: Ungatsalela nefayile kwifolda ukuyishenxisa. Bamba i-Ctrl ngoxa utsalela ukuyikopa endaweni yoko.

files-3-save-copy-move.tip: Ifayile enqunyulweyo ihlala apho ikhoyo de uyincamathisele, ngoko akukho nto ilahlekayo ukuba uphazanyiswa embindini.

files-4-find-and-recover.title: Ukufumana nokubuyisela iifayile
files-4-find-and-recover.summary: Khangela ifayile, ubuyise leyo uyicime ngempazamo.
files-4-find-and-recover.desc: Wonke umntu uyayilahla ifayile ngexesha elithile. La manyathelo akunceda uyifumane kwakhona, okanye uyibuyise.

steps.0: Kwi-File Explorer, cofa ibhokisi yokukhangela phezulu ngasekunene uchwetheze inxalenye yegama lefayile.
steps.1: Vula i-'Quick access' (ebizwa ngokuba yi-'Home' kwi-Windows 11) ukubona iifayile ozivule kutshanje.
steps.2: Cofa isihloko esithi 'Date modified' ukubeka umsebenzi wakho omtsha ngaphezulu kwifolda.
steps.3: Ukuba ucime ifayile ngempazamo, vula i-Recycle Bin kwi-desktop yakho.
steps.4: Cofa ngasekunene kwifayile ukhethe i-Restore. Ibuyela kwifolda eyivela kuyo.

files-4-find-and-recover.tip: Xa ungenise i-Recycle Bin, iifayile zinzima kakhulu ukubuya. Yijonge phambi kokuba uyingenise.

files-5-back-up.title: Ukugcina ikopi yomsebenzi wakho
files-5-back-up.summary: Gcina umsebenzi ngamnye kwiindawo ezimbini ubuncinci.
files-5-back-up.desc: Iilaptop ziyalahleka, ziyaphuka kwaye ziyabiwa. Gcina imisebenzi yakho kwiindawo ezimbini ubuncinci, ukuze ingxaki enye ingakuthinteli umsebenzi wakho.

steps.0: Ngena kwi-OneDrive usebenzisa idilesi yakho ye-imeyile yeyunivesithi. Iifayile zakho ziyakopa ekloudini ngalo lonke ixesha unxibelelene ne-intanethi.
steps.1: Gcina imisebenzi yakho kwifolda yakho ye-OneDrive, okanye tsalela iifolda zakho zemodyuli kuyo.
steps.2: Linda uphawu oluluhlaza olulungileyo kwifayile. Lithetha ukuba ifayile igqibile ukukopa ekloudini.
steps.3: Gcina ikopi yesibini kwi-USB drive kwimihla yokuphela ebalulekileyo.
steps.4: Gcina ikopi phambi kokungenisa, naphambi kokuhlaziya okanye ukuseta kwakhona ikhompyutha yakho.

files-5-back-up.tip: Iikhompyutha zelebhu ziyabelwana. Gcina kwi-OneDrive okanye kwi-USB drive, kwaye ungayishiyi ikopi enye kuphela kwikhompyutha.

files-6-types-and-sharing.title: Iintlobo zeefayile nokwabelana
files-6-types-and-sharing.summary: Zithetha ntoni i-.docx ne-.pdf, nokuba uthumela njani iifayile ngokukhuselekileyo.
files-6-types-and-sharing.desc: Oonobumba emva kwenqaku egameni lefayile bubonisa uhlobo lwefayile nokuba yeyiphi iprogram ekuvulayo.

steps.0: I-.docx yidokhumenti yeWord, i-.xlsx yishiti yeExcel, i-.pptx yiPowerPoint kwaye i-.pdf ibonakala ifana kuwo onke amagajethi.
steps.1: Ukubona ezi noonobumba, vula ithebhu ye-View kwi-File Explorer uphawule i-'File name extensions'.
steps.2: Ngenisa uhlobo lwefayile olucelwa ngunjingalwazi wakho. Kwi-PDF, khetha i-File, uze ukhethe i-Save As okanye i-Export, ukhethe i-PDF.
steps.3: Ukuthumela iifayile ezininzi kunye, zikhethe, cofa ngasekunene, khetha i-'Compress to ZIP file' uncamathisele i-ZIP.
steps.4: Kwiifayile ezinkulu, yabelana ngekhonkco le-OneDrive endaweni yokuncamathisela ifayile kwi-imeyile.
steps.5: Vula kuphela izincamathiselo ezivela kubantu obaziyo. Iifayile ze-.exe ne-.zip ezingaziwayo zinokuphatha iintsholongwane.

files-6-types-and-sharing.tip: Jonga igama lefayile phambi kokuyingenisa. Unjingalwazi uphawula oko ukulayishileyo, ngoko qinisekisa ukuba luguqulelo lwamva nje.

cyber-safety.title: Ukhuseleko lwe-intanethi
cyber-safety.subtitle: Fumanisa ubuqhetseba, khangela ngokukhuselekileyo, kwaye ukhusele isixhobo sakho nobumfihlo bakho.

safety-1-scams.title: Ukubona ubuqhetseba ne-phishing
safety-1-scams.desc: I-phishing yi-imeyile, i-SMS okanye umyalezo we-WhatsApp wobuxoki oziyeka ngathi ngumntu omthembileyo, njengeyunivesithi, ibhanki okanye isibonelelo semali. Izama ukuba iinkcukacha zakho okanye imali yakho.

steps.0: Yehlisa isantya xa umyalezo ubonakala ungxamile. Abaqhetseba bathi izinto ezinjengokuthi 'yenza ngoku' okanye 'iakhawunti yakho iza kuvalwa'.
steps.1: Jonga ukuba ngubani ngokwenene othumele. Jonga idilesi epheleleyo ye-imeyile, hayi nje igama elibonisiweyo.
steps.2: Musa ukucofa ikhonkco ongalilindelanga. Chwetheza idilesi yewebhsayithi ngokwakho endaweni yoko.
steps.3: Ungaze wabelane ngegama lokugqitha, i-PIN, ikhowudi yexesha elinye okanye inombolo yomfundi ekuphenduleni umyalezo. Imibutho yokwenene ayiyicelli ezi zinto.
steps.4: Yiba nesikrokro ngeenkonzo ezivakala zilungile kakhulu ukuba zibe ngamanyani, ezinjengedatha yasimahla, imisebenzi elula okanye isibonelelo semali ongazange ucele.
steps.5: Ukuba awuqinisekanga, musa ukuphendula. Dlulisela umyalezo kwi-IT Services uze uwucime.

safety-1-scams.tip: Qinisekisa nomthumeli usebenzisa inombolo yefowuni okanye iwebhsayithi oyithembileyo kakade, ungasoze usebenzise eyethathwe kumyalezo.

safety-2-browsing.title: Ukukhangela ngokukhuselekileyo ne-Wi-Fi kawonke-wonke
safety-2-browsing.desc: Phantse yonke into oyenzayo kwi-intanethi idlula kwiwebhsayithi okanye kwinethiwekhi ye-Wi-Fi. Imikhwa embalwa ikugcina ukhuselekile kuzo zombini.

steps.0: Khangela ipadlokhi ne-https ekuqaleni kwedilesi yewebhsayithi phambi kokuba ufake iinkcukacha zobuqu.
steps.1: Khuphela ii-app kuphela kwi-Play Store okanye kwi-App Store, kunye neeprogram kuphela kwiwebhsayithi esemthethweni.
steps.2: Ukhathalele kwi-Wi-Fi yasimahla kawonke-wonke. Musa ukwenza ibhanki okanye ukufaka amagama okugqitha kwinethiwekhi ongayithembiyo.
steps.3: Ekhampasini, xhuma kwinethiwekhi esemthethweni ye-eduroam, hayi kwinethiwekhi evulekileyo enegama elifanayo.
steps.4: Phuma kwiikhompyutha ezabelwanayo nezelebhu xa ugqibile, uze uvale ibhrawuza.
steps.5: Musa ukuphawula i-'remember me' okanye i-'save password' kwikhompyutha eyabelwanayo.

safety-2-browsing.tip: Ipadlokhi ithetha kuphela ukuba unxibelelwano luyimfihlo. Ayibonisi ukuba iwebhsayithi inyanisekile, ngoko usabhekisisa idilesi.

safety-3-device.title: Ukukhusela isixhobo sakho
safety-3-device.summary: Gcina ifowuni yakho nelaptop zikhuselekile, nomsebenzi wakho kunye nazo.
safety-3-device.desc: Ifowuni yakho nelaptop ziphethe imisebenzi yakho, imifanekiso neeakhawunti. Zikhuseleni ngendlela ekhusela ngayo ingxowa yakho yemali.

steps.0: Vala ifowuni yakho nelaptop nge-PIN, igama lokugqitha, umbala weminwe okanye ukuvula ngobuso.
steps.1: Faka uhlaziyo xa lubonakala. Uhlaziyo lulungisa imingxunya yokhuseleko esetyenziswa zizigebenga.
steps.2: Gcina i-antivirus ivuliwe. I-Windows Security ikwenza oku simahla kwikhompyutha ye-Windows.
steps.3: Musa ukushiya ilaptop okanye ifowuni yakho yodwa kwilayibrari, kwilebhu okanye kwiteksi.
steps.4: Vula i-Find My Device kwi-Android, okanye i-Find My iPhone, ukuze ufumane okanye ucime ifowuni elahlekileyo.
steps.5: Gcina ikopi yomsebenzi wakho, ukuze isixhobo esilahlekileyo okanye esosulelekileyo singakuthinteli umsebenzi.

safety-3-device.tip: Bhala inombolo yolandelelwano yelaptop yakho uyigcine kwindawo ekhuselekileyo. Iyanceda ukuba ufuna ukuxela ubusela.

safety-4-privacy.title: Ubumfihlo, iinkonzo zentlalo nokufumana uncedo
safety-4-privacy.summary: Cinga phambi kokwabelana, kwaye wazi into omayiyenzile ukuba izinto ziphosakele.
safety-4-privacy.desc: Oko ukuposayo kunokuhlala kwi-intanethi iminyaka. Cinga phambi kokwabelana, kwaye wazi into omayiyenzile ukuba into iphosakele.

steps.0: Cinga phambi kokuposa. Nantoni na oyabelana ngayo inokukopwa, nokuba uyayicima kamva.
steps.1: Gcina inombolo yakho yomfundi, inombolo yesazisi, idilesi neshedyuli yakho iyimfihlo.
steps.2: Sebenzisa iisetingi zobumfihlo ukuze abantu obaziyo kuphela bebone oko ukuposayo nemifanekiso yakho.
steps.3: Ungaze wabelane ngemifanekiso yobuqu yakho okanye yabanye abantu ngaphandle kwemvume.
steps.4: Ukuba umntu ukuhlukumeza okanye ukusongela kwi-intanethi, musa ukuphendula. Thatha izikrini, ummeme uze uxelele umntu omthembileyo.
steps.5: Ukuba iakhawunti yakho ihlaselwe okanye uwele kubuqhetseba, tshintsha igama lakho lokugqitha ngoko nangoko uze uqhagamshelane ne-IT Services.

safety-4-privacy.tip: Ukuhlukunyezwa kwi-intanethi akuzange kube yityala lakho. Icandelo leNkxaso kule app lingakubonisa abantu abanokunceda.

password-safety.title: Ukhuseleko lwegama lokugqitha
password-safety.subtitle: Yenza igama lokugqitha eliqinileyo, ligcine likhuselekile kwaye wongeze ukukhuseleka okongezelelweyo.

password-1-strong.title: Ukwakha igama lokugqitha eliqinileyo
password-1-strong.desc: Ukuba igama lokugqitha lide kwaye lingaqhelekanga, kunzima ukulikhawula. Ubude bubaluleke ngaphezu kweempawu ezikrelekrele.

steps.0: Zama ukuba nokungenani iimpawu ezili-12. Ubude bulungile ngakumbi.
steps.1: Sebenzisa ibinzana lokugqitha: amagama amane okanye ngaphezulu angahleliwe, anjenge-'purple-bicycle-river-toast'.
steps.2: Yongeza amanani okanye iimpawu ukuba uyathanda, kodwa ungazithembi ukuba zenze igama lokugqitha elifutshane liqine.
steps.3: Musa ukusebenzisa igama lakho, umhla wokuzalwa, inombolo yomfundi, inombolo yefowuni yeselula okanye i-'password123'.
steps.4: Phepha iipateni eziqhelekileyo ezinjenge-123456, i-qwerty okanye igama leqela olithandayo.

password-1-strong.tip: Ibinzana elide elithetha into kuwe kuphela lilula ukulikhumbula kwaye linzima ukulaphula kunemidididi emifutshane enje-P@ssw0rd.

password-2-keep-safe.title: Ukugcina amagama akho okugqitha ekhuselekile
password-2-keep-safe.summary: Igama lokugqitha elinye kwiakhawunti nganye, kwaye ungalabeli mntu.
password-2-keep-safe.desc: Igama lokugqitha eliqinileyo lincedisa kuphela ukuba akukho mntu ulifumeneyo. Gcina ngalinye liyimfihlo, kwaye lahlukile.

steps.0: Sebenzisa igama lokugqitha eliyahlukileyo kwiakhawunti nganye ebalulekileyo, ingakumbi i-imeyile yakho yomfundi nebhanki yakho.
steps.1: Ungaze wabelane ngegama lokugqitha nomhlobo, unjingalwazi okanye nabani na okuthumelela umyalezo. Akukho mntu wokwenene ulifunayo.
steps.2: Sebenzisa umphathi wamagama okugqitha ukuze akukhumbuze. Ifowuni yakho okanye ibhrawuza inokuba sele inayo.
steps.3: Musa ukugcina amagama okugqitha kumaphepha anamatheleyo, okanye kwifayile eyodwa ebizwa ngokuthi 'passwords' kwikhompyutha yakho.
steps.4: Ungaze uchwetheze igama lokugqitha emva kokucofa ikhonkco kumyalezo. Yiya kwiwebhsayithi ngokwakho.

password-2-keep-safe.tip: Ukuba iwebhsayithi enye ihlaselwa kwaye usebenzise igama lokugqitha elifanayo kuyo yonke indawo, izigebenga ziya kulizama kuwo onke amanye amaakhawunti akho.

password-3-two-step.title: Ukukhuseleka okongezelelweyo, nokuba wenze ntoni xa kuvuza
password-3-two-step.summary: Ukujonga kumanyathelo amabini nokwenza ngokukhawuleza emva kokuvuza.
password-3-two-step.desc: Ukuqinisekiswa kwamanyathelo amabini kongeza ukujongwa kwesibini, ngoko igama lokugqitha elibiweyo lodwa alanele ukungena kwiakhawunti yakho.

steps.0: Vula ukuqinisekiswa kwamanyathelo amabini, okubizwa ngokuba yi-multi-factor authentication, kwi-imeyile yakho nakwamanye amaakhawunti abalulekileyo.
steps.1: Sebenzisa i-app yokuqinisekisa okanye ikhowudi ethunyelwe kwifowuni yakho njengenyathelo lesibini.
steps.2: Gcina iikhowudi zakho zokugcina indawo ekhuselekileyo, ukuba ulahlekelwa yifowuni yakho.
steps.3: Ukuba ucinga ukuba igama lokugqitha livuzile, litshintshe ngoko nangoko, uze ulitshintshe naphi na apho ulisebenzise khona.
steps.4: Ungajonga ukuba idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ivele kwikhefu ledatha elaziwayo kwi-haveibeenpwned.com.
steps.5: Ukuba awukwazi ukungena kwiakhawunti yeyunivesithi, qhagamshelana ne-IT Services ukuze bayiseta kwakhona.

password-3-two-step.tip: Ungaze unike umntu ikhowudi yokuqinisekisa, nokuba ngumntu othi uvela kwiyunivesithi okanye kwibhanki yakho.

responsible-ai.title: Ukusetyenziswa kwezixhobo ze-AI ngokuzibophelela
responsible-ai.subtitle: Sebenzisa i-AI ukufunda, jonga oko ikuxelela kona, kwaye uhlale unyanisekile emsebenzini wakho.

ai-1-what-it-is.title: Oko izixhobo ze-AI ezinokukwenza nezingakwaziyo ukukwenza
ai-1-what-it-is.desc: Izixhobo ze-AI ezinjengeechatbot zinokubhala, zichaze kwaye zishwankathele ngemizuzwana. Ziincedisi eziluncedo, kodwa azihlali zichanekile.

steps.0: Isixhobo se-AI siqikelela amagama anokubakho. Asazi ukuba into iyinyani na.
steps.1: Inokunika iimpendulo ezivakala zizithembile kodwa ziphosakele, okanye yenze izinto, amaqhalo neereferensi.
steps.2: Inokuphinda iingcinga ezingakhuselekanga ezivela kwizinto eyazifunda.
steps.3: Ayithatheli indawo yokucinga kwakho, unjingalwazi wakho okanye incwadi yakho yokufunda.
steps.4: Phatha oko ikuthethayo njengomzekelo wokuqala okanye indawo yokuqala, ungasoze ukuthathe njengempendulo yokugqibela.

ai-1-what-it-is.tip: Ukuba impendulo ibaluleke ngokwenene, yijonge kwiinkcukacha zakho, kwincwadi yakho yokufunda okanye kwiwebhsayithi enokuthenjwa.

ai-2-learn-not-cheat.title: Ukusebenzisa i-AI ukufunda, hayi ukurhweba
ai-2-learn-not-cheat.summary: Yeyiphi indlela elungileyo yokuyisebenzisa, neyaphula imithetho.
ai-2-learn-not-cheat.desc: Ukungenisa umsebenzi obhalwe yi-AI uthi ngowakho luhlobo lokurhweba. Ukuba isetyenziswe kakuhle, i-AI inokukunceda uqonde ngakumbi.

steps.0: Funda isikhokelo semodyuli yakho neziqinisekiso zovavanyo. Unjingalwazi ngamnye usetha imithetho yokusetyenziswa kwe-AI kwimodyuli yakhe.
steps.1: Ukuba awuqinisekanga ukuba isixhobo siyavunyelwa, buza unjingalwazi wakho phambi kokuba usisebenzise.
steps.2: Ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo: yicele ichaze ingcinga ngamagama alula, ikuvavanye phambi kovavanyo, okanye icebise indlela yokucwangcisa isincoko.
steps.3: Ukusetyenziswa okunobungozi: ukuyenza ibhale umsebenzi wakho, ikhowudi okanye iimpendulo, uze uzingenise njengomsebenzi wakho.
steps.4: Ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwe-AI kuvunyelwe, chaza ukuba uyisebenzise njani, ngendlela acela ngayo unjingalwazi wakho.
steps.5: Yenza ukucinga nokubhala ngokwakho, ukuze ukwazi ukuchaza umsebenzi wakho kuvavanyo okanye kwi-oral.

ai-2-learn-not-cheat.tip: Ukuhlolwa okulungileyo: ungayichaza uze uyikhusele yonke umgca womsebenzi wakho ngaphandle kwesixhobo se-AI esivuliweyo?

ai-3-privacy.title: Ukukhusela ubumfihlo bakho nge-AI
ai-3-privacy.desc: Okoukuchwethezayo kwisixhobo se-AI kunokugcinwa, kwaye kusetyenziswe yinkampani eyisebenzisayo.

steps.0: Musa ukuchwetheza inombolo yakho yomfundi, inombolo yesazisi, amagama okugqitha, idilesi okanye iinkcukacha zebhanki kwisixhobo se-AI.
steps.1: Musa ukunamathelisela ulwazi lobuqu ngabanye abantu, njengemifanekiso okanye imiyalezo yabo.
steps.2: Musa ukunamathelisela umsebenzi wabanye, njengovavanyo lukanjingalwazi okanye umsebenzi wesifundo, ngaphandle kwemvume.
steps.3: Jonga iisetingi zobumfihlo zesixhobo, uze uvale imbali yencoko okanye uqeqesho ngedatha yakho ukuba unako.
steps.4: Ukhathalele ii-app zasimahla ezicela iimvume ezininzi.

ai-3-privacy.tip: Umgaqo olula: ukuba ubungayibeki kwibhodi yeendaba kawonke-wonke, musa ukuyibeka kwincoko ye-AI.

ai-4-check-and-credit.title: Ukujonga nokwamkela iziphumo ze-AI
ai-4-check-and-credit.summary: Yiqinisekise, yibeke ngamagama akho, kwaye unyanisekile.
ai-4-check-and-credit.desc: Phambi kokusebenzisa nantoni na esinikwa sisixhobo se-AI, yijonge, kwaye unyanisekile ngokuba ivela phi.

steps.0: Jonga inyaniso nganye, umhla, inani negama kwimithombo enokuthenjwa.
steps.1: Khangela nayiphi na incwadi, inqaku okanye amaqhalo ayinikayo. Izixhobo ze-AI ngamanye amaxesha zenza iireferensi ezingekhoyo.
steps.2: Kwikhowudi, yiqhube uze uyivavanye. Qinisekisa ukuba uyayiqonda inxalenye nganye phambi kokuyisebenzisa.
steps.3: Beka iingcinga ngamagama akho. Ukukopa umbhalo we-AI ngqo emsebenzini wakho kunokubalwa njengobusela bemibhalo.
steps.4: Sebenzisa indlela yokubhekisa icelwa sisebe lakho, ulandele imithetho yalo ekukhankanyeni i-AI.
steps.5: Xa unesithandabuzo, yiba nenyaniso ngayo uze ubuze unjingalwazi wakho.

ai-4-check-and-credit.tip: Unoxanduva lwayo yonke into oyingenisayo, kubandakanywa nawaphi na amaphutha esiwenzele wona isixhobo se-AI.
